name: AI Commerce V4.2 - 01D System Health Test

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT value FROM system_settings WHERE key='control_spreadsheet_id') AS control_spreadsheet_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses WHERE active) AS active_businesses,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_accounts WHERE active) AS active_accounts,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_accounts WHERE active AND COALESCE(operations_spreadsheet_id,'')='') AS accounts_missing_spreadsheet,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE active) AS products,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_base WHERE active) AS faq_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversations WHERE human_mode) AS human_conversations;
